sv.title: Sandviks storkund höjer investeringsbudget
sv.summary: Sandviks brasilianska storkund Petrobras höjer sin investeringsbudget med 12 procent till motsvarande 1.250 miljarder kronor under de närmaste fem åren. Det meddelar oljejätten samma dag som den svenska verkstadsjätten håller kapitalmarknadsdag.

en.title: Sandvik's major customer raises investment budget
en.summary: Sandvik's Brazilian major customer Petrobras is raising its investment budget by 12 percent to the equivalent of SEK 1,250 billion over the next five years. The oil giant announces this on the same day that the Swedish engineering giant holds its capital markets day.
